root_motivation: WHO: the coding agent asked for a data-subject access request, the customer leaving, and Joe answering 'is the export complete?'. WHAT: an export whose completeness is a test, and a manifest a human can read as the record of what was and was not included. WHY: a DSAR answered from an archive that silently omits calls, audit rows and blobs is incomplete and nobody can tell; a schema walk that fails CI for any tenant-scoped table that is neither an archive class nor a documented exclusion makes completeness a checked fact.
user_persona: An autonomous coding agent that runs host.export, reads manifest.json (data_classes with sha256, excluded with reasons) and tells its user exactly what the archive holds and omits, polls host.runs.get for entries_done/entries_total, and an operator who adds a table with tenant_id and is told by CI to archive it or exclude it with a reason.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given a migrated db, When the schema walk runs with its covered set fixed to the source tables of the 14 ArchiveEntry variants shipped at 6c0de78 and an empty exclusions list, Then the uncovered list is non-empty and includes calls, tenant_audit and blobs.

Given EXPORT_EXCLUSIONS as shipped and the covered set from ArchiveEntry::source_tables, When the same walk runs, Then the uncovered list is empty; Given a test copy that adds table foo(tenant_id), Then the check fails naming foo.

Given a tenant with 2 threads of 3 messages, 4 calls, 1 secret and 2 blobs, When host.export completes, Then threads.jsonl holds 6 rows, secrets.txt the name, no entry holds the secret value, calls.jsonl has 4 lines, blobs/index.json lists 2 ids, and manifest.json.data_classes has one row per class with sha256 over that class's entries in path order.

Given an export running at 100/400 entries, When host.export is called again, Then export_in_progress {run_id, entries_done: 100, entries_total: 400} and no second run row exists; host.runs.get shows the same counters.

Given a Free tenant whose blobs rows sum to 60 MB, When host.export is called with include_blobs: true, Then it is refused quota_exceeded {export_bytes_max} before a run row exists or any blob byte is read; with include_blobs absent the export carries blobs/index.json only.
Given calllog::CallRow, When the keys of a calls.jsonl line are compared to CallRow::FIELDS and paged::CallsList::FIELDS, Then they are equal.
Given docs/tools.md, When the layout render test runs, Then the committed Archive layout table and excluded-classes table equal the render of ArchiveEntry::layout() and EXPORT_EXCLUSIONS.

Given prod after deploy, When a synthetic tenant is exported and its manifest.json read, Then data_classes lists at least 12 classes and excluded names meter_events (Live; evidence: MCPHOST_LIVE=1 MCPHOST_URL=https://mcphost.dev cargo test --test expc_ac08_live_prod_manifest_classes)
acceptance_criteria.test: deferred: Live (prod; evidence: MCPHOST_LIVE=1 MCPHOST_URL=https://mcphost.dev cargo test --test expc_ac08_live_prod_manifest_classes)

scope: src/export.rs (Exclusion, EXPORT_EXCLUSIONS, tenant_scoped_tables/uncovered_tenant_tables, ArchiveEntry::source_tables/class_name and the calls, tenant_audit, audit_chain, oauth_audit, triggers, blob index and blob classes, manifest data_classes/excluded, export_in_progress, progress writes); src/db.rs (export_table_rows); src/import.rs (new classes read as history only; write_progress shared); src/runs.rs (host.runs.get progress for export runs); src/handler.rs (host.export include_blobs); src/gendocs.rs and docs/tools.md (layout and excluded-classes tables); generated contracts, SDKs, docs/errors.md and docs/openapi.json for the new argument and error code.
non_goals: Org export; import of the new classes (export only, skipped on import); secret values; the end-user archive and the handle CSV; archive classes for tables the walk lists as excluded 'not yet archived'; the AC 8 prod read (operator-provisioned, deferred).

additional.no_version_bump: No version file is bumped; wm-build land bumps and tags.
additional.walk_is_the_valid_set: The schema walk decides what is uncovered; no document lists tables by hand and docs/tools.md tables are rendered from the enum and EXPORT_EXCLUSIONS.
additional.secrets_never_exported: secrets.txt carries names only and no archive entry holds a secret value.

five_whys_trace.q: Why can an agent not say whether an export is everything the host holds?
five_whys_trace.a: The archive is the ArchiveEntry set and nothing compares it to the schema.
Tables were added over time with a tenant_id and no step asked whether the export carried them.

five_whys_trace.q: Why does the manifest not say what is left out?
five_whys_trace.a: It lists entries only; no class or exclusion is recorded in it.

five_whys_trace.q: Why must the valid set be the schema?
five_whys_trace.a: A hand-kept list of tables drifts the first time a migration lands; the schema walk fails CI at that moment.

five_whys_trace.q: Why a typed in-progress error with counters?
five_whys_trace.a: An agent that gets the same run id back cannot tell a stuck export from a slow one.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Which tenant-scoped tables are archive classes and which are exclusions?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: The walk surfaced calls, tenant_audit, audit_chain, oauth_audit, triggers and blobs as classes; the other tables are exclusions with a reason, and tenant-held data no class carries yet is stated as 'not yet archived' in the manifest rather than left out silently.

ambiguities_resolved.question: What does the class table column name?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: The class's source tables joined by a comma; empty for a class read from the tenant's own table file or computed.

ambiguities_resolved.question: What counts as an entry in entries_total?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: Every archive entry except manifest.json, the same count host.import uses.
